races.name: Napoleons Casino Hull Handicap

runners_data.name: Sir William
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing improved form for new yard but needs strong pace to be effective over this trip
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in both runs for new yard this season and overall record is now 1-15
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m2f, good) for William Haggas last August; struggled on first two runs for new yard but returned to form when second of seven back at Windsor (11.5f, good) 12 days ago; first-time cheekpieces go on now.

runners_data.name: Mafting
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form at this distance and effective on good going with strong course record
runners_data.comment: Failed to crack it in 2025 handicaps; 1st and 2nd this year in Class 5, but e-w contender
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to crack it in 2025 handicaps but reappeared to win off a reduced mark in nine-runner race at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) this April; backed that up when second at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) and this is easier than the York Dante meeting handicap he contested last time.

runners_data.name: Sportingsilvermine
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse badly out of form this season, needing everything to fall right despite being well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Well handicapped on exploits last term but down the field in his three runs this year
runners_data.spotlight: Did well last spring and was placed five consecutive times last summer/autumn; now well handicapped on those exploits but beaten upwards of 8l on all four outings this year; can't rule out a revival but hard to be confident.

runners_data.name: Impartiality
runners_data.note: Versatile runner who can adapt tactics, proven course winner with solid recent efforts at shorter trips
runners_data.comment: Won first 3 handicaps in 2025; good second off this mark at Glorious Goodwood; thereabouts
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of his first three handicaps in 2025, including here (7.5f, good), and also went close at Glorious Goodwood (1m, heavy) off 2lb higher last July; unable to land a serious blow in handicaps at Musselburgh (1m1f) and Thirsk (1m) this spring but this is less competitive and he's too well treated to ignore; first attempt at 1m2f.

runners_data.name: Urban Glimpse
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter returning from 28-day break, showed promise at this distance last season on similar going
runners_data.comment: Low-mileage 4yo who may show improvement with Goodwood reappearance under his belt
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who showed promise in handicaps at around 1m2f last year, finishing runner-up twice on good; shaped as if needing his Goodwood reappearance after a gelding operation and remains one who should be up to winning handicaps this season; non-runner due to unsuitable ground on good to firm at Windsor earlier in the week but should have a big say if allowed to take his chance.

runners_data.name: Moonjid
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheekpieces again after recent improvement, only 8 days since last run at Nottingham
runners_data.comment: Nottingham winner last October off 4lb lower; best run since when 4th in headgear latest
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a breakthrough win at Nottingham (8.3f, good); ran his best race since when fourth back at Nottingham six weeks ago (cheekpieces first time) but failed to build on it when fifth at Pontefract (1m, good to soft) last Friday; well beaten on previous attempt at 1m2f (for another yard).

races.paceDynamic: Urban Glimpse is the sole confirmed front-runner with Mafting, Moonjid, and potentially Impartiality sitting prominent, creating a moderate pace scenario rather than a cavalry charge. The lack of multiple speed horses means Urban Glimpse can dictate terms without serious pressure through the early stages at 1m2f. With three hold-up horses (Sir William, Sportingsilvermine, Impartiality) needing to make up ground, the tactical shape strongly favours prominent runners and pace-setters who can control the tempo and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Urban Glimpse gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: Urban Glimpse sets sustainable fractions and proves hard to peg back, while Mafting and Moonjid track into ideal positions. The hold-up brigade struggles to make meaningful inroads against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Mafting and Moonjid press Urban Glimpse early creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Sir William and Impartiality benefit most from the strong gallop over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: Sportingsilvermine and Sir William get the perfect setup for their hold-up style despite recent poor form. The race becomes a sprint from the furlong pole where class can tell.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If Urban Glimpse sets steady fractions but faces late pressure from prominently-ridden rivals
scenarios.body: Moonjid's recent Nottingham form and cheekpieces help him bridge the gap between pace and closers. The race becomes tactical but not slow enough for pure hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: Urban Glimpse's fitness after 28-day layoff could see him weaken markedly in the final furlong if the pace becomes searching
Mafting's prominent style may force him to track Urban Glimpse closely, potentially compromising his finishing kick if the pace becomes genuine
Sir William's recent form improvement under new connections could continue if he gets the strong pace his hold-up style requires
Sportingsilvermine has been beaten 8+ lengths on all four runs this season, making any market support highly suspicious
Moonjid's cheekpieces reapplication after a decent Nottingham effort suggests connections expect another step forward

races.name: Hilary Needler Trophy EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cornish Pol
runners_data.spotlight: £6,000 daughter of New Bay and the first foal of a twice-raced sister to 7f Group 3 winner/1,000 Guineas runner-up Lady Kaya; bred for further and would be a surprise winner on debut.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Mystery
runners_data.spotlight: 220,000gns breeze-up buy; sister to 5f winner Lochaber (RPR 70) and half-sister to Enchanting Empress who was a sharp early 2yo in 2024 with a win in the Listed National Stakes at Sandown; the yard's 2yos have been doing well, including an impressive first-time-out winner in the Wathnan silks at Bath last week; market confidence behind this one could prove significant.

runners_data.name: Roots In Touche
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £165,000 at the breeze-ups and bred to be sharp, being a sister to 5f winner Ancient State (RPR 75) and half-sister to last year's dual 5f 2yo Listed winner Ipanema Queen; in good hands and needs checking out in the betting.

runners_data.name: Rollthedicebaby
runners_data.spotlight: Soldier's Call filly who made an encouraging start to her career when chasing home subsequent Marygate runner-up Armor Supreme at Goodwood (5f, good) four weeks ago; open to progress.

runners_data.name: Crystal Queen
runners_data.comment: Another breeze-up purchase who fetched 70,000gns; market should be enlightening
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled hard but showed promise when chasing home a Royal Ascot-bound colt from the Karl Burke yard in a three-runner race at Ayr (5f, good) ten days ago; likely to improve for stable which has won this twice since 2018.

runners_data.name: The Resdev Roman
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1, prominent for long way when midfield on 6f York Dante meeting debut (good) 16 days ago; the drop to 5f could suit on that evidence and she's open to progress.

runners_data.name: Kodi Bear Light
runners_data.spotlight: Built on her Musselburgh debut second to Lily Agnes runner-up Hickory Lad when making all in 5f Thirsk maiden (good) a fortnight ago; the outside draw isn't ideal but there was plenty to like about the way she got things done at Thirsk and she could have plenty more to come for her leading yard.

runners_data.name: The Can Can Queen
runners_data.spotlight: Left her C&D debut fifth behind when winning at Ripon (6f, good) 13 days ago and the fifth gave the form a boost when going close at Redcar earlier in the week; likely to improve again.

runners_data.name: Silesia
runners_data.comment: Promising third when an 11-4 shot on Thirsk debut and should improve for the run
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on both starts, showing fair form when runner-up over C&D (good to soft) 26 days ago; may do better again.

runners_data.name: Moonlight Tango
runners_data.spotlight: All the sharper with a run behind her when making all in a C&D maiden (good to soft) 26 days ago; that form isn't anything special but she has the potential for better again.

races.name: Beverley Two Year Old Trophy EBF Conditions Stakes (Colts & Geldings) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Arapaho Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected strong pace, 28 days freshness ideal, and pulled clear convincingly on debut suggesting untapped ability.
runners_data.comment: 42,000euros half-brother to winner in Malaysia; dam 5f winner; yard's first 2yo went close
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled 2.5l clear of a next-time-out winner when overcoming inexperience to make a very promising winning debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; looks a surefire improver.

runners_data.name: Big Cigar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical speed, £140,000 purchase suggests quality, and 11-day turnaround keeps him sharp for this step up in class.
runners_data.comment: Out of the yard's Barbanera; picked up for £140,000 at the breeze-up sales recently
runners_data.spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up purchase who was sent off favourite and made no mistake on 6f Newcastle debut 11 days ago; open to progress for a yard no stranger to success in this.

runners_data.name: Blue Pete
runners_data.note: Unraced with unknown style but breeding suggests class, making debut in stakes company indicates stable confidence despite trainer's modest recent record.
runners_data.spotlight: 140,000gns half-brother to some quite useful winners, including as 2yos; will need to be good to make a winning debut at this level but the stable has had some very smart 2yos for these owners in recent years.

runners_data.name: Clash Of Hearts
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace scenario, York form gives him experience against quality fields, and 16-day gap provides freshness advantage.
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to a smart 2yo for this yard in 2024; needs a betting check
runners_data.spotlight: Fared best of the newcomers when third past the post (subsequently promoted to second) in 15-runner novice at York (6f, good) on debut 16 days ago; likely to build on that promising start.

runners_data.name: The Dancing Pirate
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but fourth on debut raises stamina questions over 5f, though three winners emerging from that Newmarket race boosts the form.
runners_data.spotlight: Could manage only fourth of seven when sent off favourite on 5f Newmarket Guineas meeting debut (good to firm) but three winners have come out of that race and he's evidently well regarded by a leading stable which has won two of the last four runnings of this.

runners_data.name: Matteo
runners_data.note: Front-runner with proven course dominance over several rivals, 37-day break suggests he's been saved for this target, and highest RPR rating in field.
runners_data.spotlight: Coulsty colt who was way too good for his eight rivals (including Ronson) on his C&D debut (good) 37 days ago; presumably saved for this since and a bold show looks assured from the inside stall.

runners_data.name: Martial Order
runners_data.note: Prominent style but faded badly on debut suggests stamina limitations, though powerful Burke yard wouldn't run without some hope.
runners_data.spotlight: 11-2 when fading into sixth behind Big Cigar on his 6f Newcastle debut 11 days ago; it's of some interest that his very powerful yard is prepared to pitch him at this level but he'll require significant improvement to get heavily involved.

runners_data.name: Wait Geordie
runners_data.note: Lead style but Chester failure under pressure raises questions about handling a sustained battle, visor indicates breathing or focus issues.
runners_data.spotlight: On the back of a Bath debut success (5f, good; made all) he was sent off favourite for the Lily Agnes at Chester (5f, good again) but could only manage third after showing speed again; has a visor added now; his outside draw could make life awkward.

runners_data.name: Ronson
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has rebounded well from Matteo defeat, 18-day turnaround keeps him race-fit, but may lack the class to reverse previous form.
runners_data.spotlight: 12l behind Matteo on his C&D debut but was a totally different proposition when 5l winner back here (good to firm) 18 days ago; may not have beaten much but open to further progress for a stable which has really found form.

runners_data.name: Concert Pitch
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but inconsistent course form and disappointing Windsor effort last time suggests he's regressing rather than improving.
runners_data.comment: Close second at Beverley latest and he's open to more progress upped in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over C&D on his first two starts but no match for Matteo on debut and could only manage sixth at Windsor (6f) last week; outsider.

races.paceDynamic: Matteo, Wait Geordie, and Ronson will battle for the early lead in this 5f sprint, with Matteo having already dominated both Wait Geordie and Ronson in previous encounters. The strong pace will be sustained by their rivalry, creating a searching gallop that will test stamina reserves over this flat, straight Beverley track. Big Cigar, Clash Of Hearts, The Dancing Pirate and Concert Pitch will jostle for prominent positions behind the leaders, creating congestion approaching the final 2f. This genuine pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses like Arapaho Gold who can finish fastest, while prominent runners with tactical pace like Big Cigar can also benefit if they secure a clean run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Matteo, Wait Geordie and Ronson engage in a fierce early battle through quick fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will weaken in the final furlong as their stamina gives way, opening the door for horses finishing from off the pace. Arapaho Gold's hold-up style becomes the winning formula as the front-runners pay for their early exertions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Sustains Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front three (most likely Matteo) can dictate terms without being pressed too hard early
scenarios.body: The leader will maintain a strong rhythm without burning up, making it difficult for closers to make up ground in the short 5f trip. Matteo's proven course form and superior class rating make him the likely beneficiary of controlled aggression.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Win
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go too fast but the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in time
scenarios.body: The race will fall to a horse tracking the leaders who can quicken at the right moment without getting involved in the early pace battle. Big Cigar's debut impression and tactical positioning give him the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Matteo breaks clear early and the other front-runners fail to keep tabs on him
scenarios.body: His class advantage over this field allows him to build an unassailable lead that the closers cannot peg back over the sprint distance. His previous course dominance over several of these rivals supports this front-running victory.

watchPoints.text: Matteo breaks clear early and the other pace-setters fail to go with him, potentially setting up an unassailable lead
Traffic problems developing 2f out as four prominent runners (Big Cigar, Clash Of Hearts, The Dancing Pirate, Concert Pitch) converge behind the leaders
Wait Geordie's visor effectiveness as he showed signs of not handling pressure when favourite at Chester
Blue Pete's market move given his debut in stakes company suggests stable knows he has the ability to compete first time out
Arapaho Gold's position tracking the pace as his hold-up style needs the leaders to come back to him in the final furlong

races.name: Birch Flooring Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Urchin
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven course form and tactical advantage in a race lacking early pace pressure
runners_data.spotlight: Promising third on 1m Ripon debut (good to firm) last summer and returned to make all with ease in a 1m3f novice there (good to soft) six weeks ago; that was a weak race but he could do no more than hack up and there could be plenty more to come.

runners_data.name: Who's Lope
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse still learning his trade but showed promise at Salisbury despite greenness under McDonald
runners_data.comment: Looked in need of the debut experience at Kempton (1m) in December; since been gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Green on his debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in December; still didn't look the finished article on his recent Salisbury return (1m2f, good) but showed plenty of promise in staying on for 6l second behind a very useful type; the type to keep on improving as his stamina is drawn out (half-brother to useful 1m6f winner).

runners_data.name: Hamadhan
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer who needs to rediscover his best form after disappointing recent handicap efforts
runners_data.comment: Never-nearer remote 7th on yard/handicap debut at Chester; this stiffer track could suit
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form on final Irish start (about 1m2f; AW) last September; a little below that level in two 1m4f handicaps for new yard and even a return to his best may leave him vulnerable against a couple of progressive 3yos from top stables.

races.paceDynamic: Urchin will make all from the front with no natural pace pressure from Who's Lope and Hamadhan, both confirmed hold-up horses. This creates a sustainable tempo allowing Urchin to dictate terms throughout the 1m4f journey on good to firm ground. The lack of early pace will result in a methodical gallop until the final 3f when the hold-up pair must make their moves. This race shape strongly favours the leader Urchin, who can control fractions without pressure and kick clear when the closers are still gathering momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Urchin maintains his front-running style without early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The confirmed leader dictates comfortable fractions and has too much in reserve when Who's Lope and Hamadhan finally challenge in the straight. Urchin's recent course success and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Who's Lope produces the finishing kick hinted at during his promising Salisbury return
scenarios.body: The Balding-trained three-year-old times his run perfectly as Urchin weakens in the final furlong after making the running. McDonald's patient ride pays dividends as the progressive type finds another gear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Experience Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If Hamadhan's four-year-old stamina kicks in during the final 2f of this staying test
scenarios.body: The veteran grinder wears down his younger rivals through relentless galloping, with Mulrennan's tactical nous helping him find the best ground. His recent runs suggest the ability is still there.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Urchin goes too fast early trying to build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The front-runner burns out dramatically in the final quarter-mile, allowing both hold-up horses to sweep past. The race becomes a sprint finish between Who's Lope and Hamadhan.

watchPoints.text: Urchin building an unassailable lead through the first half-mile with no pace pressure applied
Who's Lope travelling smoothly in rear turning for home as he showed flashes of ability last time
Early pace development as both hold-up horses may be reluctant to press Urchin early
Ground conditions staying good to firm as any ease would favour the closers over Urchin
Hamadhan's jumping ability translating to stamina reserves in the final 2f of this staying test

races.name: Happy Birthday Colin "Spud" Stamford Handicap

runners_data.name: Bell Shot
runners_data.note: Lone leader who must handle pressure from large chasing pack and justify 10-day turnaround
runners_data.comment: On last winning mark but he needs to rediscover his spark on this drop back in grade
runners_data.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 6f success at Southwell and comes here on the back of a good third of 11 in 7f Kempton handicap; this three-time C&D scorer must enter calculations.

runners_data.name: Goldmoyne
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent AW form but limited turf experience on similar going
runners_data.comment: In good form prior to C&D last time, when he had an excuse for his mid-division finish
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a four-timer on the AW at Lingfield in March; posted another solid effort when fifth of 11 in 7f Newmarket handicap two weeks ago so he can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Diligent Resdev
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 21-day break with cheekpieces fitted for first time
runners_data.comment: Failed to win last year but ran some good races, including on his reappearance; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Ayr Bronze Cup winner in 2024 who also posted some good efforts without winning in 2025; beat one on his return in 7f Haydock handicap after nine months off but he should strip sharper now.

runners_data.name: Havana Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-and-distance form advantage returning from 21-day layoff
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 with two solid AW runs (after a wind op); returns to turf in a competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; back from five months off with respectable sixth of ten in 7f Haydock handicap three weeks ago; can build on it from an easing mark.

runners_data.name: Capital Guarantee
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who disappointed last time and needs to bounce back from poor Thirsk effort
runners_data.comment: Winner of his only C&D start, last May; later successful off this mark; close 2nd latest
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time 7f/1m winner in 2025; good C&D runner-up in April but beat only one in 1m Thirsk handicap two weeks ago; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Billyb
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner looking rusty on return but has winning course form and longer trip suits
runners_data.comment: As good as ever last year, winning twice, but returns from an absence minus cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Signed off for 2025 with 1m win at Southwell; looked rusty after five months off when eighth of nine in 1m Pontefract handicap last month; took this prize in 2024 so not dismissed with usual cheekpieces refitted.

runners_data.name: Roberto Caro
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent current form dropping back to 7½f after 6f success
runners_data.comment: Three creditable efforts this year and he remains feasibly treated; respected back on AW
runners_data.spotlight: Has started 2026 in very good nick, third of six in 6f Southwell handicap last month; not out of things eased 1lb.

runners_data.name: Frankies Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with strong 2025 form record who had traffic problems at Thirsk last time
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a fine 2025 when a six-time winner (from 5f to 7f); ended up with a lot to do when good third of 13 in 1m Thirsk handicap two weeks ago so he's a player off an unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Physique
runners_data.note: Prominent runner reunited with previous trainer but showed signs of keen racing last start
runners_data.spotlight: Has rejoined Micky Fenton and not seen to ideal effect under an aggressive ride when third of seven in 7f Yarmouth handicap 17 days ago; can make his presence felt off a 2lb lower mark here.

runners_data.name: Glenfinnan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tendency to fade in finish and winless since August 2024
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since August 2024 but he's hinted at promise of late, set plenty to do (also slipped on bend) when seventh of 12 in 7f Thirsk handicap two weeks ago; needs considering off a falling mark.

runners_data.name: Benacre
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent course form but disappointed at Musselburgh nine days ago
runners_data.comment: Solid efforts over C&D on his last two starts but more will be needed in this higher grade
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (7f) in February and in good form since until a below-par fifth in 7f Musselburgh handicap nine days ago; he's the sort to bounce back but drawn wide here.

races.paceDynamic: Bell Shot will lead unchallenged from the gates with prominent runners Goldmoyne, Havana Blue, Roberto Caro, Physique, Glenfinnan and Benacre settling behind him. This creates a sustainable pace with Bell Shot able to dictate terms without pressure, while the large prominent group will track comfortably before the hold-up horses Diligent Resdev, Capital Guarantee, Billyb and Frankies Dream find their rhythm at the rear. The lack of genuine pace pressure early will set up a sprint finish where the prominent trackers and strong-finishing hold-up horses can sweep past a potentially vulnerable lone leader. This race shape strongly favours hold-up runners and strong finishers who can close from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Bell Shot sets uncontested fractions and the prominent group tracks too close
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows closers to stay in touch before unleashing superior finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Hold-up specialists with proven finishing speed capitalize on the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: A well-positioned tracker uses the perfect stalking position to time their challenge and holds off late closers. The tactical advantage of being close enough to the pace but not trapped proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bell Shot Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very steady and Bell Shot has enough left in reserve
scenarios.body: The leader maintains rhythm throughout and finds enough in the tank to repel all challengers in a slowly-run race. His course experience and tactical advantage of controlling the tempo proves crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the large prominent group goes too fast trying to stay close to Bell Shot
scenarios.body: Early pace pressure causes multiple horses to stop in the final furlong, allowing a patient hold-up horse with the strongest finish to come through. The race becomes a pure staying test in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Bell Shot must be watched for signs of early pressure from the large chasing pack compromising his stamina reserves
Glenfinnan has shown a pattern of fading in the final furlong which could be exposed again here
Capital Guarantee needs to show bounce-back from poor last-start effort where he beat only one horse
Diligent Resdev sports first-time cheekpieces after 21-day break which could sharpen his finishing kick
Frankies Dream had traffic problems at Thirsk last time and will benefit from a clearer passage here

races.name: ICS Cleaning Services Handicap

runners_data.name: Clear Above
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who needs the pace to collapse but has solid form at this level
runners_data.comment: 0-5 and he's been well held in both handicaps; needs improvement back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Proving a consistent sort and comes here on the back of a solid third of seven in 1m Ripon handicap 22 days ago; not out of things on his first go over this trip.

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who hung and idled when caught at Ripon, must overcome tendency to tie up in front
runners_data.comment: Unexposed gelding who was an eye-catching fourth at Wolverhampton; respected back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive form since switched to handicaps this season, though he hung and idled in front before being caught post when a short-head second of eight to Vietnorm at Ripon (1m2f) 22 days ago; 1lb better off here so big shout.

runners_data.name: Vietnorm
runners_data.note: Much improved since gelding with a course and distance win, perfectly suited to pick up the pieces
runners_data.comment: Well held at big prices in all five runs; gelded and steps up to 1m2f on return
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded and much improved when gaining a first win in 1m2f handicap at Ripon 22 days ago, collaring Bradbury on post; merits serious consideration despite 3lb rise.

runners_data.name: Wadacre Geisha
runners_data.note: Showed clear improvement on handicap debut over this course and distance just 18 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Study Of Man filly who took a step forward on her handicap debut when second of nine over C&D 18 days ago, collared only late on; well in the mix nudged up 1lb.

races.paceDynamic: Bradbury is the only natural pace-setter in this small field and will likely dictate terms from the front without serious pressure. Clear Above, Vietnorm, and Wadacre Geisha all prefer to settle and come from behind, creating a scenario where Bradbury can control the tempo through measured fractions. With no early pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for the front-runner to steal a march, though if he idles in front again, the closers have every chance. This race shape strongly favours the early leader who can control his own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bradbury Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Bradbury jumps well and settles into an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable fractions and kick clear when ready, avoiding the idling issues that cost him at Ripon. The three hold-up horses will struggle to peg back a horse with first run on them from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Bradbury idles or ties up in the final furlong like at Ripon
scenarios.body: The three closers can time their challenges perfectly and collar him near the line. Vietnorm and Clear Above have the best turn of foot to capitalize on any front-running collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gradual Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses tracks closer than usual to keep Bradbury honest
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine test that could find out Bradbury's stamina reserves over this longer trip. Wadacre Geisha showed good staying power when second over course and distance recently.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Bradbury misses the break or gets shuffled back early
scenarios.body: The race loses its natural shape with no obvious leader, creating a stop-start affair that suits none of them particularly well. Clear Above's consistency could prove valuable in a scrambled contest.

watchPoints.text: Bradbury's jumping - if he misses the break he loses his natural tactical advantage and the race shape changes completely
How close the hold-up horses track to Bradbury early - if one sits closer than usual it could create genuine pace pressure
Vietnorm's position turning for home - he needs to be within striking distance to use his proven finishing kick
Bradbury's behavior in the final furlong - watch for signs of hanging or idling that cost him victory at Ripon
The pace through the first half-mile - if too slow it plays into the hands of the three closers

runners_data.name: Maple
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent good form who benefits from the expected steady pace and lack of early pressure
runners_data.comment: In good form over hurdles/on the Flat but may find others better handicapped
runners_data.spotlight: In winning form over hurdles this spring and he posted a good third of nine in C&D handicap last month; enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Langton Wold
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 17-month absence with significant fitness concerns despite past ability
runners_data.spotlight: Capable of fair form but he hasn't been seen out since runner-up over fences at Catterick 17 months ago; others are preferred on this occasion.

runners_data.name: Copper And Five
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form whose experience at course and distance is a major positive
runners_data.comment: Won this race last year and was runner-up off this mark over C&D last month; shortlisted

runners_data.name: Nakatomi
runners_data.note: Prominent type still seeking first win but comes here in good form after recent Hamilton second
runners_data.comment: Yet to score but good third of 14 in 8.5f Beverley handicap 11 days ago; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to register a victory but he comes here on the back of a good second of eight in 1m handicap at Hamilton 15 days ago; not out of things.

runners_data.name: Bullington Bry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose poor recent form and headgear changes suggest continued struggles likely
runners_data.spotlight: 0-20; tried in different headgear when a below-par seventh in 7f Doncaster handicap last time out; usual cheekpieces are refitted.

runners_data.name: Elettaria
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose poor 2024 form continues with disappointing recent Redcar effort
runners_data.comment: Fair run when fifth over C&D last time but has a bit to find with a couple of these rivals

runners_data.name: Langholm
runners_data.note: Front-runner who gets uncontested lead but current form is well below required standard
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 below par and yet to hit top form this season, well held in 7f Catterick handicap last time; this course winner needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Evelyn's Phoenix
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent form dip masks ability and benefits from expected pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Capable at this level but his latest Beverley run was underwhelming
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Nottingham (1m) in April but his form has dipped of late, just sixth in 1m Ayr handicap last time; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Oilisa
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose autumn wins at this trip contrast sharply with poor current season form
runners_data.comment: Landed a brace at Ayr and Nottingham around 1m last October on heavy.
runners_data.spotlight: Scored twice at 1m last autumn but she's yet to fire in 1m handicaps at Doncaster and Ripon this season; needs to take a major step forward.

runners_data.name: Penny Ghent

runners_data.name: Caledonian Dream

runners_data.spotlight: Off for 11 months since a good second in 1m2f handicap here on his final run for Alan Brown; has fitness to prove for his new handler.

runners_data.name: Far Ahead
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose dismal current form makes him hard to recommend despite suitable race shape
runners_data.spotlight: Largely out of sorts this season, beating just two in 1m Ripon handicap last time; not easy to make a case for.

runners_data.name: Anificas Beauty
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose poor Pontefract effort suggests continued struggles at this level
runners_data.comment: 5 wins at up to 9.4f; stays 1m3f but likely there will be stronger stayers in the line up
runners_data.spotlight: Comes here under a cloud, last of seven in 1m4f handicap at Pontefract eight days ago; hard to warm to.

races.paceDynamic: Langholm is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead with Penny Ghent, Copper And Five, Nakatomi and Bullington Bry tracking behind in the prominent positions. The pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing Langholm to dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. This setup creates an ideal scenario for hold-up horses like Maple, Evelyn's Phoenix and Elettaria to close from off the pace. The lack of pace pressure and single leader heavily favours hold-up horses who can time their challenge perfectly in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Langholm sets modest fractions without pressure and the prominent horses fail to kick early enough
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows closers to time their runs perfectly while the front division lacks the speed to resist late challenges. Maple and other hold-up types benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Success
scenarios.trigger: If Copper And Five or Penny Ghent track the leader closely and produce strong finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their tactical speed to bridge the gap between pace-setters and closers. Their class and recent form proves decisive in a moderately-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Langholm improves dramatically from recent poor form and gets away with soft fractions
scenarios.body: The veteran front-runner steals a march on the field and holds on grimly despite his poor recent efforts. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to find his old form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely slow and the race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: All runners bunch up turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish where any horse can win. Fitness and draw become more important than running style.

watchPoints.text: Langholm could set very soft fractions as the lone leader which would significantly help all hold-up horses
Penny Ghent may press Langholm early given his front-running tactics which could change the entire pace dynamic
Copper And Five showed good recent form at this course and benefits from having Joanna Mason's course knowledge
Maple returns to handicaps after hurdles success and the steady pace setup suits his hold-up style perfectly
Caledonian Dream faces major fitness test returning from 11-month absence despite previous course form
